pattern.description: Reverse of a UI push-in: the zoomed screen recording pulls out to reveal the full app window floating on a white canvas with a blue arc, while a loading spinner keeps turning and its status line swaps from '0% Complete' to 'Transmitting data...'.
pattern.why_premium: The pull-out reframes a raw screen recording as a framed product card with shadow and brand-colour backdrop, giving context during an otherwise dead loading state instead of cutting.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.app-window', {scale: 1.5, xPercent: 10, yPercent: 10}, {scale: 1, xPercent: 0, yPercent: 0, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); spinner runs a continuous rotation tween (repeat: -1, ease: 'none'); status text swapped with a quick opacity crossfade.
build_hint.remotion: Interpolate scale 1.5 -> 1 and translate on the window container over ~27 frames with Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic) (or spring {damping: 200} for no overshoot); spinner rotate = frame * 12deg; status text switched by frame threshold.

notes: camera.move is pull_out; modelled as the window card scaling down. Pattern ui_camera_push_in used for the inverse (pull-out) move as no pull-out pattern exists. b03 marks where the spinner sat before the pull-out (empty at end), not a separate element.
